chronology.event: Roric arrives at Castle Tarn and requests aid for Khazad-Throm.
The three paladins agree that the Dragon Rider Order will intervene; Alaric leads the expedition.
A dozen Dragon Riders, Roric, Eloran and Caradoc travel to Khazad-Throm.
King Thordal hosts the visitors and explains the kingdom's culture and war.
A formal mutual-defense alliance is negotiated.
Gawain joins the campaign; allied forces win the Battle of Durin's Chasm.
Alaric, Caradoc and dwarven sappers flank through Broken Shard Passage and break the enemy line.
The Valley's larger army and Percival arrive for the final assault on the Goblin Burrow.
Grishnak is defeated and organized goblin resistance collapses.
Khazad-Throm and the Valley celebrate together and publicly affirm their alliance.
Borin Stonehand becomes ambassador in River City.
Dwarven engineers establish a moderate mine and permanent settlement in the Valley, beginning sustained trade and knowledge exchange.
